notes.title: 1.0.2 The Profanity Update (Added ****, $#@!, and REDACTED)
notes.notes:
Added limited profanity into the game (profanity is disabled be default)
Added profanity toggle to the profile menu in settings.
Moved some words from default dictionary to profanity dictionary.
Fixed bug with SFX slider in audio menu not moving.
Added version number to settings menu.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed leaderboard display issue where long usernames were running over their line.
 Fixed issue where UI was not displaying points earned when using powerups (Note: Points were being awarded, but the amount of points were not displayed at the top of the screen)
 Fixed issue where there was no audio queue when getting points when using a powerup.
